data.gender_notes: Muiz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'A-W-Z', meaning to revive, bring back to life, or reform. In Islamic history, Muiz was the name of a famous caliph who restored the Islamic state and improved the lives of his people. May this name inspire you to bring renewal and rejuvenation to your own life and the lives of those around you. The name Muiz carries the meaning “Reviver, Reformer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muiz usually hope their child will grow to embody reviver, reformer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Muiz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reviver, Reformer.”

in_arabic.name: مُعِز
in_arabic.meaning: المنعم بذكره، المعز من الله تعالى، ذو الشرف والجلال
